reason: Setting a GRUB2 boot loader password modifies the bootloader configuration. An incorrect password or misconfiguration can prevent the system from booting, resulting in loss of console access and requiring physical intervention. The policy explicitly classifies bootloader changes as too dangerous to remediate automatically.
estimated_impact: reboot required; authentication/authorization affected; Potential boot lockout if password is mistyped; Loss of remote console/SSH access until physical access is obtained; System may become unbootable after updates if GRUB configuration is corrupted
